title: Audit missing information paths in the fixed P104 joint flags
body:
PR2981's 208 full helper flags realize both endpoint covers but leave a concrete information-flow gap. With its exact intermediate frames, only **323 of 4,992** required `I-G/2` source/target pairs are reachable in the frozen X-only monotone common-chart model. A 22-frame forward-closed cut separates `X4` from `Y0`, where the correction coefficient must be `-1/2`.

Adds one opt-in package, `research/p104-flag-information-flow`, with a written support-invariant proof, exact input pins, complete pair relation, cut witness and replay. Source-bitset propagation and a separate reduced-basis/per-source BFS independently reconstruct the same receipt without importing predecessor implementations. The relaxation grants all source snapshots, arbitrary interleaving and free mixing, with restoration requirements dropped, so nonreachability already rejects this named witness before chronological synthesis.

This corroborates PR2981's stated static-versus-program boundary; it is not a defect in its certificate. Different intermediate flags/matchings, original-helper reads, target feedback and changed frame operations remain outside scope. No new lifetime floor, supplier, kappa or construction expansion.

Validation on macOS arm64, CPython 3.12.14 and optimized 3.14.7:

- `python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-flag-information-flow`: both algorithms and seven behavioral groups pass, including positive multihop relays, all 32 small edge subsets, direction/cut controls, equivalent bases, source/receipt corruption and Git-free read-only exports.
- Selected source-binding baseline and PR2981's independent static-cover checker pass. No selected cold/native/all-size replay or hosted CI success claimed.
- Publication-byte preflight checks all eight package files and four declared inputs.

Started at canonical main `b3f3ee0392b71b118fd086a6eaf6b4cab54ef455`; rebased onto revision-6 main `836b19bfa309ceafbc8ee32a15e8c4b10dde7e11`, whose P104 handoff names this same dependency question. Original scientific/provenance pins remain; the selected record and live inputs are unchanged. Final overlap covers 237 open PRs and 1,703 Discussion records with complete pagination; arbitrary diffs/unpublished work are outside coverage.

Credit Nick Petalas/PR2981/2920, Adam Gall/PR2090 and Jeremy Diviney/PR2113's earlier information-flow work, and the retained P104 relay/geometry/native contributors named in the README. Prepared for Arham Tahir with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; no subagents or independent human/formal review.

[Canonical investigation and task](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2245#discussioncomment-18977808). Complete costs, chronology and restoration remain obligations for a changed candidate; the next bounded step is a changed named collection passing every required path before scalar synthesis.
